description: Attempt to reduce PDF file size by rebuilding the document structure. Copies all pages to a fresh PDF (dropping orphaned objects), and optionally strips metadata. Results vary; works best on PDFs with accumulated edits or orphaned data.

flattenForms.description: Flatten form fields to reduce size (default: false)

stripMetadata.description: Remove title, author, subject, keywords (default: false)

name: pdf_compress
